title: Migratory Birds of the Americas Conservation Enhancements Act of 2023
official_summary:
Migratory Birds of the Americas Conservation Enhancements Act of 2023

This bill reauthorizes through FY2028 and revises the Neotropical Migratory Bird Conservation Act, which provides financial assistance for projects to promote the conservation of neotropical migratory birds. The bill increases the cap on the federal share of project costs. It also directs the Department of the Interior to report on an advisory group established under the act. If applicable, Interior must include a description of the composition of the advisory group in the report.

summary.headline: Law extends and updates a federal grant program that helps pay for conservation projects for birds that migrate across the Americas.
summary.what_it_does: The law renews the Neotropical Migratory Bird Conservation Act's grant program through fiscal year 2028. It raises the limit on how much of a project's cost the federal government can pay. It also requires the Department of the Interior to report on an advisory group set up under the program, including who is on it if applicable.

who_it_affects.group: Groups and agencies that run bird conservation projects
who_it_affects.how: They can keep applying for federal grants through 2028, and the federal government may now cover a larger share of project costs.
It must continue running the grant program and write a report on the program's advisory group.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: Enacted April 24, 2024; the program is reauthorized through fiscal year 2028.
